production_checks.comparison: ASCII letters first, digits/underscore later, C11keywords andstdinttypedef excluded; bindings protectstdio names. Strict supported subset; actual identifiers are short/nonreserved and every actual reference was manually checked against parameters, locals, functions or stdio.

Independent base10 digit folding and <2^63; leading zeros excluded except0. Zero is the C octal-zero spelling with the same value, a harmless aligned convention. Integer typing/conversions are separate.

Every compound operand is parenthesized; names/numbers/postfix calls provide unambiguous token boundaries. Assignment/indexlvalues andprefix++/--/& shapes checked. No cast or postfixincrement production; actual code uses neither.
Onlyint/uint64_t/uint64_t* with explicitname andoptionalinitializer. uint64_t depends on the documentedstdint implementation contract. No declaration is accepted as a controlled statement.

Blocks contain declarations/statements; null/evaluation/return statements terminate withsemicolon. Everyif hasmatchedelse; forhasoneordinarydeclarationinitializer, semicolon-delimitedcondition andstep; while/for bodies are statements. Actual nested branches/loops have the intended attachment.

Functions require a compound body; actual counter2definitions, driver4parameterprototype,2positive staticarrays, intmain with emptyparameters. Arraycapacity1500000 is unchanged. Scope/type/linkage constraints are not generally enforced by this surface grammar.

Frozenv3 excludesbackslash/questionmark andliteral*/ and permitsASCIIcommentcharacters; phase1trigraph andphase2splicing cannot create a terminator. Actual fixedcopyright hasonlybasiccharacters. Fixedstdint/stdio includes are recognized; contents/headerimplementation remainexternal.

Independent source-spelling derivations describe preprocessing source plusfunction/global structure, not a fullpreprocessedISO-Ctypedtranslationunit. Driverenforcesint main/noformalparameters. This is genuine AST-structural correspondence in the specified surfacefragment; not tokenlistequality.
